fact.claim: In compliance mode, a vault lock has a cooling-off period from the creation of the vault lock until the vault and its lock become immutable; you choose the duration of this period, called grace time, and it must be at least 3 days (72 hours).
fact.question: What is the minimum grace time before a compliance-mode vault lock becomes immutable?
